title: Quiz: NodeJS IO Mastery
alt: A weathered wooden waterwheel at the edge of a flowing river receives water into individual bounded cups while the larger current continues past mossy stones.
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a wide16:9 environmental editorial photograph for a NodeJS IO quiz about reading a file in manageable chunks, streaming and bounded buffering. Depict a real-looking fast shallow woodland river in cool early autumn light. At its near bank stands one large weathered wooden scoop waterwheel, a mechanically believable wheel with six to eight deep separated wooden cups around its circumference. A narrow wooden side flume diverts a small portion of the passing river into ONE upper cup; the next cup below visibly spills its contained water back into the current. The larger silver river continues across the whole background, not trapped inside a machine. The relationship is clear: an enormous continuous source is handled one bounded portion at a time. The wheel is a thoughtful physical metaphor for chunks, not a fake Node diagram or throughput claim.
Camera: close environmental documentary photograph at bank height looking slightly upstream, wheel occupies central-right half, broad river sweep on left, wet mossy stones close in foreground and rich dark real woodland receding above. A measured long exposure makes the current a beautiful silver continuous flow while wheel and water-filled cup remain sharply legible. Subtle motion only in river, no blurry wheel. Weathered oak, dark wet slate, real moss, small golden fallen leaves, cold silver water. Beautiful restrained natural color, tactile material detail, fine analogue film grain, believable overcast sky light with slight warm glancing sun at the wheel edge. Artful independent journal photography, expansive real setting rather than product catalog or miniature. Keep flume/cup/current relationship within central65percent for eventual square recomposition. No paper sheets, stacks, ribbons, cutout fields, diagrams, arrows, words, text, numbers, logos, watermark, UI, electronics, flat beige backdrop, glossy3D, toy scale, futuristic lighting or decorative machinery unrelated to the water. Do not exaggerate into a factory: one plainly built wheel, one small flume, a living river.
notes: Replaces the repetitive v4 paper curl/stack proposal with an environmental photographic lane. A continuous river feeds one visibly bounded wheel cup while lower cups spill onward; it is a chunk-processing metaphor, not a literal Node implementation or measured backpressure diagram. Natural weathered wood, moss, wet stone, woodland depth and long-exposure current make this a different scale, material and setting. At thumbnail size the wheel/current relation reads; a fresh square should gather the upper feeding cup and spilling cup against a compact river sweep, not crop away the supply. Shallow2.25:1 clips lower wheel but keeps the feeding portion visible. Originalv4 and current covers retained. No square or frontmatter changes.
alternatives: One portion of the river (selected): environmental waterwheel captures bounded portions of a continuous source.
A flowing stream passes a series of natural stone basins without storing the whole current.
A real river ferry carries a bounded load across flowing water.

title: Quiz: 9 JavaScript Promise Questions
alt: An expressive printed orchard branch holds green and ripe fruit; one ripe fruit falls toward a woven sling that carries caught fruit onward above the dark orchard floor.
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a wide16:9 mature expressive editorial monotype and woodcut print for a JavaScript promises quiz about pending work, fulfilled values, rejected work and recovery that lets a chain continue. Make an atmospheric orchard narrative, not a diagram: one strong sinuous dark tree branch sweeps through the upper-middle, carrying two small green unripe pears and several larger golden-orange ripe pears. One ripe pear is visibly falling from the central branch toward a small woven harvest sling stretched between two lower branches; the sling contains two caught pears and extends toward a further living leafy branch, suggesting that catching a fall can carry useful work onward. A single dark bruised pear sits on the ground below, showing that not every fall was caught. The unripe, ripe, falling and caught states are readable natural relationships, not labeled classes. Avoid implying failure automatically disappears; the sling must visibly do the recovery work.
Image-making: vigorously inked handmade monotype on fibrous print paper, layered charcoal woodcut gestures for bark and grass, loose ochre dry-brush sunlight, olive and bottle-green leaves, glowing apricot fruit against smoky gray-brown orchard air. Rich uneven ink coverage, carved marks, expressive long branch curves, naturally varied orchard texture all across the image, no plain uniform colored stock field, no graphic cutout objects arranged on a tabletop. Contemporary serious editorial printmaking, artful slightly melancholic warmth, mature rather than a children's book, no cute faces or cartoon outlines. Wide spacious orchard with a sense of depth, principal branch and the caught/falling pear in central60percent, some atmospheric peripheral foliage allowed. Strong whole-scene rhythm and one clear central recovery gesture readable at200px. Full bleed art plate, no title, text, numerals, code, arrows, labels, logo, watermark, hands, human bodies, parcels, envelopes, torn paper strips, laptops, neon, corporate3D, beige machinery or border.
notes: Replaces the repeated hand/parcel/strip vocabulary with expressive printmaking and a dense natural narrative. Green hanging pears suggest waiting; ripe fruit suggests available value; one dropping pear is visibly caught by a woven sling containing earlier fruit, while a bruised pear remains uncaught below. Catching and passing onward is the quiz's recovery metaphor; the art does not claim to illustrate exact Promise state transitions. The gestural branch/fall/sling relation is strong, atmosphere and woodcut texture depart from plain paper grounds. Fresh square should recompose one hanging green pear, falling ripe pear, sling and bruised fruit around the dominant branch while reducing distant orchard. A shallow crop loses ground fruit; full16:9 preserves all narrative elements. Originalv4 and current covers retained. No square or frontmatter changes.
alternatives: Fruit, fall and recovery (selected): orchard print contrasts waiting, available values and deliberate catching.
A vigorous ink-print relay of migrating birds where one bird rejoins after a missed landing.
A storm-bent flowering branch recovers through a support, with one failed bloom below.
